entries.name: Allantoin
entries.summary: A soothing, skin-conditioning agent that supports surface renewal and comfort, commonly used to calm and smooth compromised or rough-feeling skin.

entries.name: Alpha Arbutin
entries.summary: A gentle, stabilised brightening active that targets the look of uneven tone and dark spots by moderating excess melanin at the surface.

entries.name: Azelaic Acid
entries.summary: A well-tolerated active that helps normalise the look of blemish-prone skin and even out tone; also used in its water-soluble derivative form (Potassium Azeloyl Diglycinate).

entries.name: Baicapil™ Complex
entries.summary: A botanical scalp-and-hair complex used in anti-hair-loss formulas to support the look of density and healthier growth conditions at the root.

entries.name: Centella Asiatica
entries.summary: A classic soothing botanical ("cica") used to calm the look of stressed or sensitised skin and support barrier comfort.

entries.name: Ceramides
entries.summary: Skin-identical lipids that help rebuild and reinforce the moisture barrier, reducing water loss and restoring resilience to dry, compromised skin.

entries.name: Glutathione
entries.summary: An antioxidant tripeptide used to support a brighter, more even-looking complexion while helping defend the skin against everyday oxidative stress.

products.name: Triple Action Bikini Area Whitening Cream

entries.name: Green Tea Extract
entries.summary: A polyphenol-rich antioxidant botanical (a source of EGCG) used to help defend skin against oxidative stress and support a calmer, clearer look.

entries.name: Hyaluronic Acid
entries.summary: A humectant that binds a large amount of water to the skin surface for immediate hydration and a smoother, plumper appearance, helping reduce moisture loss.

entries.name: Lactic Acid
entries.summary: An alpha-hydroxy acid that smooths surface texture and supports cell renewal while also acting as a humectant, so it exfoliates without stripping.

products.name: Triple Action Whitening Wash Gel for Sensitive Area

entries.name: Licorice Root Extract
entries.summary: A botanical extract valued both for calming the look of redness and for its gentle brightening action on uneven tone.

products.name: Triple Action Bikini Area Whitening Cream

entries.name: Mandelic Acid
entries.summary: A large-molecule alpha-hydroxy acid that exfoliates gently and evenly, making it well-suited to sensitive skin and the look of uneven tone.

entries.name: Niacinamide
entries.summary: A form of vitamin B3 that supports the skin barrier, helps regulate visible oil, and is widely used to even skin tone and calm the look of redness.

entries.name: Panthenol
entries.summary: The pro-vitamin form of B5 — a humectant and skin-conditioning agent that cushions against harsh cleansing, supports the barrier, and leaves skin soft and comfortable.

entries.name: Rosemary Extract
entries.summary: An aromatic botanical with antioxidant and skin-conditioning properties, used to support a calm, balanced-looking complexion and scalp.

entries.name: Sage Extract
entries.summary: A botanical extract with antioxidant and skin-calming properties, used to support comfort and a balanced-looking complexion.

entries.name: Salicylic Acid
entries.summary: An oil-soluble beta-hydroxy acid that works inside the pore to clear build-up and support a clearer, smoother-looking complexion in oily and blemish-prone skin.

entries.name: Saw Palmetto Extract
entries.summary: A botanical extract used in hair-thinning formulas to support a healthier scalp environment for growth.

entries.name: Shea Butter
entries.summary: A rich plant butter that nourishes and softens, reinforcing the skin's surface lipids for lasting comfort on dry and sensitive skin.

entries.name: Tranexamic Acid
entries.summary: A targeted brightening active valued for addressing stubborn discolouration and the look of uneven tone, often paired with other brighteners.

entries.name: Vitamin E
entries.summary: A fat-soluble antioxidant that helps protect the skin's surface lipids and supports softness and everyday environmental defence.

entries.name: Zinc PCA
entries.summary: A multifunctional zinc active for oily and blemish-prone skin that helps regulate visible sebum while providing surface antimicrobial support without over-drying.
